about: Listed / notable buildings of Skvyra. Coordinates from Wikidata (P625). Attributes are ESTIMATES read from the listed licensed photos (method photo_estimate, confidence medium), never measurements. Photos are referenced, not redistributed.

landmarks.name: Будівля чоловічої гімназії (Сквирський ліцей)
landmarks.evidence: Two tall storeys of ochre-salmon brick, grey sheet-metal hipped roofs with pediments; a domed corner tower is visible but NOT modelled.

landmarks.name: Костел Святого Яна Непомука
landmarks.evidence: Classicist plastered (white/grey, weathered) single-nave church with a pedimented gable and pilasters; roof of corrugated sheets. Height read from photos as about two tall storeys; towers or interior not modelled.
landmarks.note: Only footprint at the coordinate is a merged Microsoft ML outline (2,279 m2); no OSM footprint exists. Needs mapping in OSM.

landmarks.name: Будинок земської управи
landmarks.evidence: Two storeys, salmon/peach plaster with white trim and arched windows, brown metal-tile hipped roof with gabled dormers (dormers not modelled).

landmarks.name: Особняк Бабаєва
landmarks.evidence: One tall storey plus an attic with dormers, grey plaster with brick accents, brown metal roof (attic dormers not modelled).

landmarks.name: Будинок, у якому жив та працював М. Т. Рильський (дитсадок «Світанок»)
landmarks.evidence: Terracotta-red plaster with white pilasters and white window frames, brown roof; one storey judged from the eaves height in the photo.

landmarks.name: Синагога (Сквира)
landmarks.evidence: No licensed exterior photo found; only the OSM tags (building:levels=2, start_date=1711) are used. Listed so it is named and searchable.

landmarks.name: Житловий будинок (вул. Київська, 1)
landmarks.evidence: Listed monument; no photo inspected - only named and given the historic facade style.
